messages:
maya: Quick async — gatekeeper rollforward in progress. Pushing a small config change to reduce alert noise from the auth-service. Will monitor SLO impact.

arjun: Nice. Which alerts are flapping?

maya: Mostly auth-429-rate and 'prefix-cache-miss' spike. I added a 30s debounce in the alert rule and bumped the kv warmup to 3 nodes for the canary group.

sam: ping on the PR? I left one comment about the prometheus query window.

maya: thanks — grabbing your CR now. small diff, tests pass locally.

noah: Heads up — oncall noticed an increase in 503s yesterday evening after the autoscaler rollout. Could be related to kube-proxy conntrack limits.

maya: filed a ticket: OP-4721, linking runbook. I'll add a short checklist to the runbook for conntrack checks. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/conntrack

pagerduty-bot: Incident OP-4719 acknowledged by maya at 11:12 UTC.

arjun: I can validate the canary metrics once the rollout finishes. If 99th pct token latency stays < 220ms for 15m we consider it green.

maya: good gate — starting the final rollout now. command I ran:
```
kubectl rollout restart deploy/gatekeeper --namespace=infra
```

deploy-bot: deploy/gatekeeper v12.3.1 -> v12.3.2 started (triggered by maya).

sam: re: alert queries — changed query window from 5m to 10m in the PR to avoid spiky false positives. LGTM after CI.

noah: I'll watch the SLO dashboard for the next 30m and take action if token latency or error budget burn increases.

maya: blocker: Canary logs show intermittent KV eviction warnings on node-5. I'm switching that node to soft-drain and kicking a warmup job.

arjun: I can re-run the warmup job: `scripts/kv_warmup.sh --group canary --replicas 3`

maya: done — warmup job started. monitoring for cache hit rate recovery.

sam: small ops note — if alerts still chatter, let's add a temporary annotation to suppress until the full rollforward stabilizes. annotate command: `kubectl annotate pod <pod> alerts/suppress=\"gatekeeper-rollout\" --overwrite`

noah: thanks — will only suppress if noise threatens PagerDuty. otherwise prefer triage.

maya: wrap-up: PR merged, rollforward underway, warmup running, watching SLOs for 30m. If anyone sees unusual 5xx or bursty token latency call it out here. :eyes:

arjun: thanks — will post a short summary after 30m.

sam: thx. I'll follow up on the prometheus note in the PR tomorrow morning.

pagerduty-bot: Incident OP-4719 auto-resolved at 11:42 UTC (no further alerts).

noah: SLO watch green at +25m. 99th pct latency stable at 190ms. Closing loop on my side.

maya: excellent. marking OP-4721 as next action owner: noah for runbook edits, sam for alerts query follow-up.

sam: noted.

arjun: summary: rollout successful, small alert tuning applied, runbook update planned. :white_check_mark:
